name: Someeta Das

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Someeta Das writes poems, short stories and travel narratives. A retired English teacher from Maharaja Manindra Chandra College, Kolkata, she has contributed to GloMag and Setu. Her Setu story “Undercurrents” places an ordinary interruption beside an unseen emergency; “In Quest of the Celestial” brings literary memory into an account of travel through Bhitarkanika.

In “HOPE”, published here, a weary speaker looks outwards towards the suffering of war. Images of Gaza and the Strait of Hormuz give way to personified Peace, Gratitude and Hope. The poem seeks reassurance without forgetting the distress that prompted it.
